bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · back above the 200-day, under the 5-day
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 重回 200 日均线上方，仍在 5 日均线下方

read.en: Nvidia rose 2.3% on Nov 3 to $206.69, trading between $205.93 and $209.14. It is below the falling 5-day ($208.5), 10-day ($212.2) and 30-day ($222.1) and the rising 100-day ($214.6), and just above the rising 200-day ($204.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($215.95), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: 英伟达 11月3日上涨 2.3%，收于 $206.69，盘中区间 $205.93–209.14。股价位于下行的 5 日（$208.5）、10 日（$212.2）和 30 日均线（$222.1）以及上行的 100 日均线（$214.6）下方，略高于上行的 200 日均线（$204.6）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$215.95），RSI 为 39。

read.en: The close reclaimed the 200-day and the $204.6 Oct 30 close, lost on Nov 2, now support again. Resistance is $208.5–210 (5-day, Sep 14 low, Nov 2–3 highs), then $212.2–214.6 (10 and 100-day) and $216 (SAR, Oct 26 close). Support is $204.6, then $200.9–201.7 (Oct 30 and Nov 2 lows) and $198–199.3. A close above $210 would target $212–214.6; below $204.5, $201.

r.zh: 抛物线 SAR $215.95；10月26日收盘价 $216
